tasks.label: cpp-run
args:
printf '[ COMPILING ]

' > output.txt && g++ -std=c++17 '${file}' -o '${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}' > compile.log 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then printf '[ COMPILETIME ERROR ]

' >> output.txt && cat compile.log >> output.txt; else printf '[ RUNNING ]

' > output.txt && start=$(date +%s%3N) && timeout 10s '${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}' < input.txt >> output.txt 2>&1; code=$?; end=$(date +%s%3N); runtime=$((end-start)); if [ $code -eq 124 ]; then printf '
[ TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) ]
' >> output.txt; elif [ $code -eq 139 ]; then printf '
[ RUNTIME ERROR (Segmentation Fault) ]
' >> output.txt; elif [ $code -eq 134 ]; then printf '
[ RUNTIME ERROR (Abort) ]
' >> output.txt; elif [ $code -ne 0 ]; then printf '
[ RUNTIME ERROR (Exit Code: %s) ]
' "$code" >> output.txt; else printf '

[ COMPLETED ]
' >> output.txt; fi; printf '
[ FINISHED in %s ms ]
' "$runtime" >> output.txt; fi
